name: TM7 Creamy Restaurant-Style Carbonara
ingredients: 180 g smoked streaky bacon or pancetta, diced
0.5 tsp freshly ground black pepper, plus extra to serve
80 g pasta cooking water, reserved from spaghetti, as needed

steps.text: Put 90 g Parmesan into the mixing bowl and grate 10 sec / speed 10. Transfer to a bowl and set aside.
Put 2 garlic cloves into the mixing bowl and chop 3 sec / speed 7. Scrape down the sides.
Add 10 g olive oil and 180 g smoked streaky bacon or pancetta. Cook 10 min / 120°C / reverse / speed 0.5 with the measuring cup removed.

ingredientLinks.match: 180 g smoked streaky bacon or pancetta

steps.text: Meanwhile, cook 300 g spaghetti in a saucepan of well-salted boiling water until just al dente. Reserve 80 g pasta cooking water, then drain without rinsing.

Add 200 g double cream, 60 g grated Parmesan, 15 g unsalted butter, 0.5 tsp freshly ground black pepper, 1 pinch fine salt and 40 g reserved pasta cooking water. Cook 3 min / 80°C / reverse / speed 1.
Leave the sauce to stand for 1 minute. Add 2 egg yolks and mix 20 sec / reverse / speed 2 with no heat.
Add the hot drained spaghetti and mix 1 min / reverse / speed 1.5. If needed, add up to 40 g more reserved pasta cooking water and mix 20 sec / reverse / speed 1.5.

ingredientLinks.match: 40 g more reserved pasta cooking water

steps.text: Serve immediately with the remaining 30 g grated Parmesan and extra freshly ground black pepper.
